campaign: C10 -- C2 provenance repair and prospective adoption governance audit

DISCLOSURE.statement: Frozen AFTER the archaeology and the governance reconstruction, BEFORE adjudication. C10 does not claim blindness.
why_this_is_still_sound: the classes below are decided by objective predicates over committed artifacts, not by a tuned threshold
C10 computes no scientific value, so no choice here can make an unsound result look sound
the one judgement that matters -- whether a successor may freeze a new prospective rule -- is decided by QUOTED TEXT from the C2 adjudication, which C10 cannot alter

classification_predicates.PROVENANCE_CLEAN: the hash recorded in REGISTRY_C2 resolves to a real commit of the producer AND no build-path unit differs between that commit and HEAD
classification_predicates.PROVENANCE_REPAIR_NEEDED: the hash resolves but a build-path unit differs
classification_predicates.PROVENANCE_BROKEN: the hash resolves to no commit of the producer
classification_predicates.C2_RULE_GLOBAL_BINDING: some committed artifact asserts the floor binds all future successors immutably
classification_predicates.SUCCESSOR_RULE_ALLOWED: the floor declares itself prospective AND no artifact asserts permanence AND the adjudication itself provides for replacement
classification_predicates.GOVERNANCE_BRIDGE_REQUIRED: the replacement route named by the adjudication is conditioned on an open item that is not yet discharged

final_classes.combination_rule: P5 may be carried TOGETHER with P1/P2/P3, because a bridge requirement is about what a successor must do next, not about whether provenance is clean. P4 and P6 are exclusive.
